slice: Agent Home project row menu - the reference right-click menu on project rows
method: desktop patch 0022 (regenerated) + apps/macos/src/extension.ts commands + CDP right-click on the running Agents window + bun test + bun run typecheck + node scripts/ci-validate.mjs

change.desktop: agentHomeNav.ts attaches a context menu to the navigation's project rows and, through attachSessionsListMenu, to the sessions list's own project groups (delegated from the sidebar so recycled rows keep working). Every entry dispatches the folder path to a Caret extension command.
change.extension: apps/macos/src/extension.ts gains the six project operations: pin/unpin, rename (host project record, the folder is never touched), reveal (the workbench's revealFileInOS), create a worktree task, archive the project's chats (reversible: transcripts stay on disk), and remove (archives the project record - the host has no delete, and inventing one would discard transcripts the host owns). resolveHostProject matches by path first and by a unique name second, and refuses to guess when two projects share a name.
change.manifest: the six caret.project.* commands are declared in apps/macos/package.json contributes.commands, like every other Caret command.
change.failurePath: an action whose command cannot run reports a warning naming the command and the reason instead of resolving into a menu item that does nothing.

verified.liveMenu: CDP right-click on the project group row in the running Agents window: .monaco-menu-container display=block with exactly the six entries above, in that order (Pin Project at 228,395 through Remove Project at 228,515).
verified.liveDispatch: clicking Pin Project closes the menu and dispatches command 'caret.project.setPinned' with the row label; in this dev window the Caret extension is not installed, so the new failure path reported it: "Caret could not run 'Pin Project': command 'caret.project.setPinned' not found". Before this slice the same click was silent.
verified.contractTest: apps/macos/test/agent-home-project-menu.test.ts: 4 tests, 21 expects - the entries and their order match the reference, every id is a command the extension registers, right-click is bound on both project-row sources with preventDefault, and the failure path warns. Negative controls: reordering an entry, dropping a registerCommand, removing a preventDefault and removing the warning each make it fail.
